title: Company Support Chatbot (AI)
subtitle: AI Assistant for a Company's Profile, Services and Support
description: Company Support Chatbot – AI Assistant for a Client
An AI chatbot that helps a client's users learn about the company's profile and services and get support in real time.

caseStudy.summary: An AI chatbot, built with OpenRouter (DeepSeek), that helps a client's users learn about the company's profile and services and get support in real time.
problem: The client's users needed quick answers about the company's profile, services and support, at any time.
